title.narrative: Support to IFRC Syria for PGI delegate

description.narrative:
The SARC Earthquake response highlighted specific vulnerabilities among certain groups, necessitating tailored interventions like safe shelters, child-friendly spaces, GBV risk mitigation in WASH, menstrual hygiene management, and disability-inclusive responses. Institutionalising PGI into SARC’s operations is crucial. PGI is a core priority in the IFRC EQ Response Operational strategy and SARC EQ Response Plan (2023-2027) to ensure integrity and accountability to accelerate PGI (Protection, Gender, and Inclusion) work within SARC, efforts have been made by developing policies, SOPs, and mainstreaming PGI principles into programmes and services. The aim is to build on existing PGI work by strengthening specialised protection services and integrating PGI into technical sectors such as Disaster Management, CASH, Health, WASH, and Shelter.
IFRC, British RC, and Canadian RC will support the funding of the IFRC PGI delegate for six months starting in 2024, to enhance SARC’s PGI-related programming and technical capacities. The role aims to strengthen SARC’s systems and capabilities, through close accompaniment and follow ups on the core policies and mechanisms they have been building upon through their strategy. The BRC Grant will be covering 4 months of costs committed to the PGI delegate to IFRC Syria Delegation using BRC Movement Contribution funds in 2025. Funding is in CHF - 56,647.35
